goal: Prove opt-in Rust cuda-oxide direct raw-KV storage and indexer QAT execution without claiming composed FP8 storage, compressor, attention, or runtime-route ownership.

cuda_oxide.module_form: executable-local #[cuda_module] with primitive f16 conversion and libdevice-linked FP4 block scale math

covered_behavior: store_raw_kv_batch_kernel FP16 round-trip storage with ring wrap across distinct destination rows
indexer_hadamard_fp4_kernel 128-wide Hadamard transform and E2M1FN activation simulation
ds4_gpu_store_raw_kv_tensor, ds4_gpu_store_raw_kv_batch_tensor, and ds4_gpu_dsv4_indexer_qat_tensor launch surfaces
excluded_behavior: same-launch overlapping raw ring-row write ordering
attention kernels, runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, and C CUDA removal

rust_owned_in_this_stage: FP16 ring-storage and Hadamard E2M1FN numeric validation
not_claimed_in_this_stage: composed FP8 storage or compressor kernels
attention kernels, runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, or C CUDA removal

b300_execution.test_command: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup PATH=/tmp/cargo/bin:$PATH LIBCLANG_PATH=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.2 RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly-2026-04-03 cargo test --locked -p ds4-cuda --features cuda-oxide-backend -- --nocapture
b300_execution.command: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup PATH=/tmp/cargo/bin:$PATH LIBCLANG_PATH=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.2 RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly-2026-04-03 CUDA_OXIDE_BACKEND=/workspace/cuda-oxide/crates/rustc-codegen-cuda/target/debug/librustc_codegen_cuda.so CUDA_OXIDE_LLC=/usr/bin/llc CUDA_OXIDE_VERBOSE=1 cargo run --manifest-path /workspace/cuda-oxide/crates/cargo-oxide/Cargo.toml -- run --features cuda-oxide-kernels --bin ds4-cuda-raw-kv-indexer-qat-smoke
